_comment: Shared TP1 plan-% gate tunables — the single source of truth read by BOTH scripts/watch_tp1_first_arm.py and the C# app (DongGfx.App.Infrastructure.Tp1PlanGateConfig). Editing a value here changes the watcher's gate AND the app's breaker without a rebuild. Keys are mirrored 1:1 by PLAN_GATE_CONFIG_KEYS in the watcher and Tp1PlanGateConfig.Keys in the app; a missing/malformed file leaves both sides on their compiled defaults.
